chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: The Brownskin Models show and arriving in California in 1936
summary: He joined the Brownskin Models show along the way to Canada and reached Los Angeles on New Year's Day 1936.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And another show...let's see, I went back... How did I get back to Cleveland? With some other road band. I can't even think of the name of it. And somehow I got to Columbus, Ohio, which is where Sweets was playing, incidentally. This other show, Brownskin Models... I think there were two segments of this show. But anyhow, the Brownskin Models, Blanche Thompson... Bernard Miller I think was the producer. He was Olivette's father; he's long since gone. But they sent for me to join this show along the way to Canada, and that's how I got out here.

I got out here New Year's Day, 1936. I'll never forget it. Here, having only seen California in the movies, I said, "This is home." So I stayed here... I think I stayed here six years before I ever went back to New York.
